missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Техника' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Современная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'удобна' is the short-form predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Технику' is the accusative direct object of 'выпускает'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'завод' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Техники' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express none in stock. 'Такой' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'в магазине' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В технике' uses the prepositional form 'технике' after 'в' to mean being knowledgeable in it. 'Хорошо' describes the degree.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Техникой' is in the instrumental case showing what equips the plant. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'оснащён' is the short-form participle.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Технике' is in the dative case after 'благодаря' to express thanks to it. 'Работа' is the nominative subject of 'стала'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Техники' is genitive modifying 'цена' to mean the price of the equipment. 'Выросла' agrees with 'цена' in feminine gender.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Техники' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'в цехе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Техники' is genitive after 'много' to express a large amount. 'Магазин' is the nominative subject of 'продаёт'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Техника' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'помогает'. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine, and 'каждый день' marks the routine.
